headline: Iran attacks U.S. military radar system in Bahrain despite talks with mediators
summary: Iran launched drones at a US military radar system in Bahrain on Tuesday, and the crew of a tanker was reported missing in the Strait of Hormuz. The attacks occurred despite talks with mediators Oman and Qatar.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is a key chokepoint for global oil shipments, so disruptions there can quickly affect crude prices and shipping costs.
why_moved: Drone attacks on a US radar in Bahrain and a missing tanker in the Strait of Hormuz raise supply-risk concerns in a key oil shipping corridor, despite ongoing mediation talks.
original_headline: Irán ataca sistema de radar militar de EU en Baréin pese a conversaciones con mediadores
